verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs mention APIs to retrieve contacts and custom object records (e.g., GET requests) which could be used to pull data out, but there is no explicit documentation of a full data-export feature, bulk export tool, or guarantee of open/portable formats (e.g., CSV/JSON export for all objects) — the cited import/export docs focus almost entirely on importing, not exporting. Missing for 10: dedicated 'export all data' feature docs, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) export guarantees, and evidence of exporting non-CRM objects (workflows, sequences, reports) for a full data migration/exit.
